verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms developer.bigcommerce.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with structured content including an explicit 'Instructions for AI Agent' section, directly satisfying the story's requirement of agent-discoverable docs. Missing for 10: no independent/community confirmation of agents actually using it, and no broader agent-oriented doc ecosystem (e.g., MCP server, structured API docs for agents) beyond the single llms.txt file.
